bullets.text: The Tamil Nadu government allocated Rs 50 crore for startups to support animation, visual effects, gaming, and comics as it courts international studios.
A power cut hit the Thiruvallur collectorate office, prompting the office to monitor local infrastructure reliability.
The Chennai Meteorological Department warned of heavy rain in Thiruvallur district starting November 3, and the office should track weather alerts.
The Greater Chennai Corporation Council passed 38 resolutions including biomining works at Kodungaiyur and Perungudi dump yards.
Plastic waste and garbage accumulated in the Velachery Tharamani Peliayamman temple pond causing a foul smell.
The BJP took action regarding a road on temple land in Velachery Dhandeeswaram Temple under the HRCE department.
The Water Resources Department stepped up estuary dredging from Pudhupattinam to Pazhaverkadu to improve flood water discharge.
A sudden power cut interrupted DMDK leader Premalatha Vijayakanth's press meet in Tiruvallur.
Ministers announced that Andhra Pradesh paddy sacks will be permitted for sale in Tamil Nadu to control rising rice prices.
The Tamil Nadu government plans restricted Wi-Fi access for students to block harmful online games and applications.
L&T's Vyoma.AI performed a groundbreaking ceremony for its 52 MW AI-ready green data center in Chennai.
The Tamil Nadu government is training school teachers to create AI-based lessons for classroom rollout starting in November.
AMMK general secretary TTV Dhinakaran criticized the government over a power outage at the Thirumazhisai electric crematorium.
DMK leader M.K. Stalin accused the government of a total law and order collapse across Tamil Nadu.
IIT Madras and CMC Vellore developed a rehabilitation robot using interactive games to help stroke survivors regain hand function.
